description: Search Art Institute of Chicago exhibitions by text and date: what is on now, what is coming, or past shows on a topic. Results carry dates, gallery, summary, web page, and the artworks shown when the museum lists them. Pass artwork ids to artic_get_artworks for full records.

date_from.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD; an exhibition matches when its run overlaps date_from to date_to.

date_to.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD; an exhibition matches when its run overlaps date_from to date_to.

page.description: Page to return (1-based, 1-40); page times limit may not exceed 1,000.

query.description: Text matched against exhibition titles, descriptions, and other fields; every word must match.

sort.description: relevance ranks by query text; start_desc and start_asc sort by opening date. Defaults to relevance with a query, else start_desc; relevance without a query sorts as start_desc.

when.description: current: open today; upcoming: opens after today; past: closed before today; any: no date condition.

name: artic_search_exhibitions

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_range`: date_from is later than date_to. `page_beyond_window`: The API refused the page as past the first 1,000 matches (the page and limit bounds keep calls inside it). `rate_limited`: The Art Institute API throttled this server and retries ran out, or the shared request queue could not start the call in time. `request_blocked`: The Art Institute API's firewall blocked the request, as it does for markup or script-like text and for bursts of traffic. `upstream_rejected_query`: The Art Institute API rejected a request this server built from valid inputs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhibitions.description: Matching exhibitions on this page, in ranked or sorted order.

artist_ids.description: Ids of artists in the show; pass as ids to artic_search_artists or one as artist_id to artic_search_artworks.

artwork_count.description: Artworks the museum lists for the show; 0 when none.

artworks.description: Artworks shown, when the museum lists them; pass ids to artic_get_artworks.

title.description: Artwork title; absent when the museum's id and title lists do not pair up.

end.description: Closing date and time, ISO 8601 with offset.

gallery.description: Gallery where the exhibition is held.

id.description: Exhibition id; no tool fetches an exhibition by id, so each row carries the full record.

image_url.description: Exhibition image: an 843 px IIIF URL when the museum links an image id, else the museum's own image URL.

is_featured.description: True when the museum features the exhibition; absent when not recorded.

start.description: Opening date and time, ISO 8601 with offset.

status.description: Museum status label (Closed, Confirmed, Traveling). It does not say whether the show is on now; the when filter does.

title.description: Exhibition title; empty when the museum lists none.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page.

license_text.description: License statement from the API for this data, verbatim.

next_page.description: Page to request next; absent when nothing remains or the next page would pass the first 1,000 matches.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, more pages exist, or the reachable window is exhausted.

totalCount.description: Matches for the query and filters, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page.

title: Search exhibitions
